description: Phase 7 pre-stat asymmetry per openspec/specs/rewrites/spec.md:21-29 and serve-handler/src/index.js:608-642. Three anchors: (a) `extensioned_skipped`: has-extension request whose original file exists is served directly, rewrite does NOT fire; (b) `extensionless_wins`: extensionless rewrite displaces an existing original-path file (no pre-stat); (c) `extensionless_miss_falls_back`: extensionless request whose rewrite target doesn't exist falls back to the original-path's resolve (mirrors the reference's final `lstat(absolutePath)` at index.js:634-642 after `findRelated` returns null). Anchor (c) was the corner that exposed Codex round 1 P1. cleanUrls disabled in fixture to isolate phase-7 behavior.
